description: Ford's most powerful production engine ever, the supercharged 5.2L Predator powers the Shelby GT500. Unlike the flat-plane Voodoo, the Predator uses a cross-plane crankshaft optimized for forced induction. At 760 HP and 625 lb-ft of torque, it's the most powerful street-legal Ford ever produced.

heritage.significance: Most powerful production Ford engine ever built
innovations: Inverted supercharger for lower center of gravity
Charge air cooler integral to supercharger

supercharger_specifications.intercooler: Air-to-liquid charge air cooler integrated into supercharger
supercharger_specifications.orientation: Inverted for lower center of gravity

common_issues.description: Intercooler heat soak reduces power on extended track sessions
common_issues.solution: Ford Performance heat exchanger upgrade, ice in coolant tank
Transmission cooler upgrade for sustained track use

strengths: 760 HP - most powerful production Ford ever
Factory forged internals handle power well
Impressive straight-line and road course capability

notes.predator_vs_voodoo: While the Voodoo (GT350) uses a flat-plane crank for NA high-RPM performance, the Predator uses a traditional cross-plane crank that's better suited for supercharging. Different tools for different purposes.
notes.modification_potential: With pulley upgrades and tune, 900+ HP is achievable. The forged internals handle significant power increases.
notes.cooling_critical: The supercharged design generates significant heat. Intercooler and transmission cooling are critical for sustained high-performance use.
